title: Gateway event
description: One JSON object per AI gateway call. Mirrors EVENT_FIELDS in lakehouse.gateway.contract. A refused call (refused_by_gateway true) has answered_by and tokens null; a null answered_by forces tokens null, but a call that was not refused may still have a null answered_by (a backend failure or timeout, for example status 502). request_id may be a GUID (API Management's per-request ID); no other string value may be GUID-shaped.

event_time.description: When the gateway handled the call (UTC), ISO 8601 with an offset.

request_id.description: Per-call identifier (API Management's request ID, a GUID, is allowed here).

session.description: Named per live session, or 'replay' for generated events that never feed a published figure.

caller.description: A label for who called; raw object IDs never leave the gateway.

answered_by.description: The backend that answered; null when the gateway refused the call, or when no backend answered (for example, a backend failure).

tokens.description: Tokens consumed; null when the gateway refused the call, or when no backend answered (for example, a backend failure). May also be null for a non-refused call that a backend answered.

latency_ms.description: Elapsed time in the gateway, milliseconds.
